name: Default drone fleet (live cargo spawning without a scenario)
note: Read only in a session without a cargo scenario, with its first live spawn (sc.Cargo.Spawn; setting CargoFleet, -SCCargoFleet=<file|none>). Only the drone definition and the docks are used; a dock whose grid the scene does not have is left out. Two docks of two drones on the environment's first grid (a hangar's freight elevator), as in the hangar scenarios: the hangar's shared pool, which serves every grid of the hangar and its ships.
